# Type Assertion & Type Switch in Go

When working with interfaces, we often need to retrieve the underlying concrete type. Go provides **type assertion** and **type switch** for this purpose.

## Type Assertion: `x.(T)`

```go
var i interface{} = "hello"
s := i.(string)  // panics if wrong type!
fmt.Println(s)   // hello
```

## Comma-Ok Pattern

```go
var i interface{} = "hello"

s, ok := i.(string)
fmt.Println(s, ok) // hello true

n, ok := i.(int)
fmt.Println(n, ok) // 0 false — no panic!
```

## Type Switch

```go
func describe(i interface{}) string {
    switch v := i.(type) {
    case int:    return fmt.Sprintf("int: %d", v)
    case string: return fmt.Sprintf("string: %q", v)
    case bool:   return fmt.Sprintf("bool: %v", v)
    case nil:    return "nil"
    default:     return fmt.Sprintf("unknown: %T", v)
    }
}
```

## Practical Error Handling

```go
func handleError(err error) {
    switch e := err.(type) {
    case *ValidationError:
        fmt.Printf("Field %s: %s\n", e.Field, e.Message)
    case *NotFoundError:
        fmt.Printf("%s not found\n", e.Resource)
    default:
        fmt.Printf("Unknown error: %v\n", err)
    }
}
```

quiz.question_id: Apa yang terjadi jika type assertion `i.(int)` dilakukan tapi `i` berisi string?
quiz.question_en: What happens if type assertion `i.(int)` is performed but `i` contains a string?

quiz.question_id: Apa kegunaan comma-ok pattern `v, ok := x.(T)`?
quiz.question_en: What is the purpose of the comma-ok pattern `v, ok := x.(T)`?
options_id: Melakukan type assertion dengan aman tanpa risiko panic
options_en: Performs type assertion safely without panic risk
Gets the type name as a string

quiz.question_id: Dalam `switch v := i.(type)`, apa yang disimpan dalam `v` di dalam setiap case?
quiz.question_en: In `switch v := i.(type)`, what is stored in `v` inside each case?
options_id: Nilai konkret dengan tipe yang sesuai dengan case tersebut
options_en: The concrete value with the type matching that case
The type name as a string
A pointer to the interface value

quiz.question_id: Kapan sebaiknya menggunakan type switch daripada type assertion?
quiz.question_en: When should you use a type switch instead of a type assertion?
options_id: Selalu lebih baik menggunakan type assertion
Ketika ada banyak kemungkinan tipe dan perlu menangani masing-masing berbeda
Hanya ketika tipe tidak diketahui saat kompilasi
options_en: When there are many possible types and each needs different handling
Only when types are unknown at compile time
